# CoLab Lisbon

> CoLab Lisbon runs hands-on AI workshops and Claude training in Lisbon, Portugal. Learn to build products, agents, and automations with Claude and Claude Code — in person, with a community of AI builders.

## Key Information

- **Organization**: CoLab Lisbon
- **Location**: Lisbon, Portugal
- **Focus**: Claude AI training, AI agents, workflow automation, Claude Code
- **Languages**: English (primary), Portuguese (Português)
- **Target Audience**: Companies, teams and organizations; also entrepreneurs, founders and professionals

## Custom Team Training

- **What**: Live, in-person Claude and AI training for companies, teams and organizations, built around each team's real use cases
- **Where**: At the client's office, or at the CoLab Lisbon venue; team offsites in Lisbon or Ericeira
- **Formats**: Half-day intro, full-day workshop, 2-day intensive, team offsite / retreat
- **Inquiries**: https://colablisbon.com/team-training.html#inquiry
- **Instructors**: Chelsea Rustrum, James Corbett, Verena Husemann

### How It Works
1. Discovery call to understand the team, goals and current tools
2. Map the use cases with the biggest payoff
3. Hands-on, in-person training on the team's real work
4. Templates, playbooks and follow-up support

### Example Use Cases
- Marketing & content: content calendars, repurposing, brand voice guides
- Sales & client work: proposals, prospect research, follow-ups
- Operations & admin: SOPs, meeting summaries, recurring reports
- Leadership & strategy: research briefs, competitor analysis, AI rollout plans
- Product & engineering: Claude Code, internal tools, tests and documentation
- Founders & small teams: AI operating systems, automations, agents

### Who It's For
- Companies, startups, agencies, nonprofits, leadership teams, communities and coworking spaces

### Teams We've Worked With
- AI training and AI strategy for startups, gaming companies, food manufacturers, real estate developers, events teams and financial advisors
